name: lalida
description: LaLiDa - Quản lý & gọi món quán cơm gà (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + D1)

scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute lalida-db --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute lalida-db --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: wrangler d1 execute lalida-db --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute lalida-db --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build:css && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
